notes.title: Grind-rails massively improved + HUD update
notes.content:
Peace and blessings upon you all,

[h3]Demo Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] I have updated the SATORI demo with a few bug fixes, the most important one being: [b]fixed getting stuck on grind-rails at intersections[/b]. It feels like a dream to play now that this has been fixed.
[*] I have also [b]added a prototype HUD that indicates the availability of your platforming abilities[/b]. It was a quick addition, so any feedback on this is very welcome.
[/list]
[h3]Important notice[/h3]
As mentioned in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1451970/announcements/detail/2968417243095877942]previous announcement[/url], [b]today (June 27, 2021) marks the last day you can play the SATORI demo[/b] as part of its extended period from Steam Next Fest 2021. The SATORI demo will be [b]de-activated @ 11.59pm PST.[/b]

[h3]Thank you[/h3]
The number of demo downloads and the amount of positive feedback I have received has been very reassuring. I look forward to completing the game and making the most fluid and free-flowing platforming experience available.

[h1][url=https://discord.gg/bZRPSXPHCs]Join our Discord ►[/url][/h1]
If you wish to participate in future demos and playtests, I would like to warmly invite you to [url=https://discord.gg/bZRPSXPHCs]join us on Discord[/url], where regular updates and discussions will continue.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451970/SATORI/]WISHLIST on Steam ►[/url][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451970/SATORI/

Take care, everyone~

🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏
